title: Recursive tail machine
statement: Given an alphabet $\Gamma$, a number $m$ of work tapes, indices $\mathrm{src},\mathrm{dst}\in\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, and a symbol $\mathrm{last}\in\Gamma$, define a deterministic Turing machine for each $k\in\mathbb N$. For $k=0$ it writes the one-symbol word $[\mathrm{last}]$ on the destination tape; for $k+1$, it copies from the source tape to the destination tape, scans forward on the destination tape, runs the machine defined for $k$, and then scans back on the destination tape.
